description: This source file defines the `LikeFunction` class, which implements a filter function that matches a string against a pattern with wildcard support, as part of the filtering framework in the project.

classes.name: LikeFunction
classes.description: A class that implements a filtering function enabling pattern matching with wildcards '*' and '?' using regular expressions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier 'like' for this filter function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the filter check, returning true if the first parameter matches the pattern defined by the second parameter, converted to a regex.

methods.name: toJavaRegex
methods.description: Converts a pattern string with wildcards '*' and '?' into a Java-compatible regex pattern string.
